title: Three Moths

hook_line: Three moths are hidden in this Short. Find them.
first_visual: Winter Lane at night, snow falling past a streetlamp, an on-screen counter 'MOTHS FOUND 0/3'.

beats.visual: Snow falling past a streetlamp; counter MOTHS FOUND 0/3 (post).
beats.vo: Three moths are hidden in this Short. Find them.

beats.visual: Ivy with a shovel at 5 a.m.; moth 1 sits on the lamp head.
beats.vo: Every morning our path's already cleared. Nobody admits it.

beats.visual: Moth 2 is woven in Ivy's scarf pattern as she works.
Ivy glances up at Dot's dark window: a moth-shaped mark on the glass.
beats.vo: Dot's away till Friday. Her flat's empty.

beats.visual: Ivy stops; somewhere along the dark path, scraping continues.
beats.vo: I stopped shovelling. The scraping didn't.

beats.visual: Card: FOUND ALL THREE? PAUSE NOW. (2 s)
Reveal circles on moths 1 and 2, then zoom on Dot's window: the wing-spots blink.
beats.vo: That third one isn't a moth.

beats.visual: Key moment: the wing-spots blink in the dark window; black; the scraping stops just behind camera.

ending: Black. The scraping stops right behind the camera.
loop_note: Yes. Viewers rewatch to find the moths; the counter resets on frame 1.

concept: A hidden-object hunt: three moths are in the Short. Ivy gets up early to catch whoever clears the path each night. The third 'moth', on Dot's dark window, has wing-spots that blink. They are eyes, and the scraping continues behind her.

hooks.line: Three moths are hidden in this Short. Find them.
hooks.first_visual: Winter Lane at night, snow falling past a streetlamp, an on-screen counter 'MOTHS FOUND 0/3'.

hooks.line: Someone clears our path every night. Nobody admits it.
hooks.first_visual: A freshly shovelled path at dawn, no footprints.

hooks.line: Dot's away. Something's at her window.
hooks.first_visual: An upstairs window with a moth-shaped mark on the glass.

hooks.line: I stopped shovelling. The scraping didn't.
hooks.first_visual: A shovel blade frozen above snow.

hooks.line: That third one isn't a moth.
hooks.first_visual: Wing-spots on a dark window that blink.

setting: Winter Lane outside Vesper Court before dawn; Dot's upstairs window.
conflict: Ivy wants to catch the night shoveller; the viewer hunts moths.
escalation: Moth 1 on the lamp, moth 2 in her scarf pattern, moth 3 on Dot's window; the phantom scrape.
reveal: Moth 3's wing-spots blink: lamp-lit eyes of the Tenant in Dot's empty flat.
emotional_objective: Playful hunt, then a jolt; a brand easter-egg showcase.
